source.description: U.S. Forces Hunting Examination, instructor-provided historical practice paper

source.answerKeyConvention: Only yellow-highlighted answers are treated as correct. Student circles and other pen marks are not used as an answer key.
source.transcriptionNote: Question wording follows the photographed paper, including historical terminology and possible errors. Do not treat the highlighted historical answers as current legal or biological authority. Batch 2 includes PIII Q1–25, PIV Q1–25 and PV Q1–5. The partial Part V questions are retained in pendingSections and are not presented until the section is complete.
